verdict.rationale: The official clickhousectl CLI is documented to set up ClickHouse Cloud, create cloud-managed clusters, manage Cloud resources and execute queries against ClickHouse servers. ClickHouse also ships an official MCP server and offers coding-agent skills, and a probe found an OpenAPI spec, so an agent can provision and query without the dashboard. Schema application is only implied through running SQL queries. missing for 10: explicit documentation of fetching the connection string or credentials via CLI/API/MCP, an explicit schema-migration workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow.
